intro.text: A foul-smelling antiseptic of Roshar, cheaper than knobweed sap or lister's oil but weaker.

items.text: Seeking antiseptics for his bridge crew, Kaladin was offered larmic mucus as a cheaper choice, yet even a small jar cost a bridgeman ten days' pay. The prices led him to gather knobweed sap, using some and selling the rest.
